Package org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.backup

Class BackupProfile

java.lang.Object
org.jdesktop.lg3d.apps.backup.BackupProfile
public class BackupProfile extends Object
A saved backup configuration: which folders/files to archive, where to put the archive, and how to build it. Profiles are plain Jackson beans persisted by BackupStore; the class stays serialisable (no-arg constructor plus getters/setters, no live handles) so a config file survives a restart.

Sources are stored as absolute path strings. Archive entry names are derived relative to each source's parent, so backing up ~/Documents yields a top-level Documents/ folder inside the archive and a restore into /target recreates /target/Documents/....

Exclude patterns are glob expressions matched against the archive-relative entry path and the bare file name (e.g. *.tmp, *.log, **/cache/**). A directory whose relative path matches is pruned wholesale.
